name: The Barter Line
slogan: Two batteries for a goat. No questions. Some questions.

host.name: Old Tomas
host.persona: A grumpy, charming old trader who reads barter classifieds and haggles with callers live on air. He knows the value of everything in batteries and pretends he does not care about anyone, but always finds a deal for the kids.
quirks: tells callers to 'speak up, the ear's been through a war'

topics: a goat that keeps being traded back
the rules of the barter line
